storyTitle: Track Holiday Spending Progress and Bill Reductions
oneSentenceStory: Review current coin balance and statement credit accumulation toward the Holiday Spending Money goal.
customerSituation: Customer visits rewards overview to check cashback earnings and monitor progress against bill-reduction targets.
storyTension: Ensuring transparent cash-equivalent value and clear visibility into automatic payment allocations without promotional distractions.
customerResolution: Clear display of 7,300 coins translated into statement credit value, with direct progress tracking on the holiday spending goal.
primaryOutcome: Effortless verification of cash-equivalent rewards and clear visibility into bill-reduction progress.
